text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"multiple developed paragraphs","quality":"organization","description":"It presents ideas in a more extended, clearly separated structure rather than a single run-on paragraph."},{"evidence":"repeated linking phrases like \"First thing,\" \"Therefore,\" \"Last thing\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"It uses more overt discourse markers to connect sections and signal progression of ideas."},{"evidence":"\"I will try to take more years of school...\",\"\"I have also wanted to rap\",\"\"I already play soccer\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"It develops points with several supporting details and examples instead of briefly listing ideas."},{"evidence":"\"Pass your class or no fun in life,\" \"The limits of your language are the limits of the world\"","quality":"idiomatic phrasing","description":"It shows more control of set expressions and memorable phrasing, even when some usage is still awkward."},{"evidence":"\"accomplish\",\"\"important aspect,\" \"vocabulary\"","quality":"word choice","description":"It uses a somewhat broader and more precise vocabulary than the other essay."},{"evidence":"\"I have stared to play basketball more,\" \"we can travel and see how people live\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"It has more varied sentence patterns and somewhat better overall syntactic control despite frequent errors."}]}
